# Supporting material: permit status lookup (example)

## Permit Tracker export (sample columns)

Permit number, Address, Applicant name, Applicant phone, Status, Status date, Inspector

## Status values in use today

Submitted, In review, Corrections needed, Approved, Issued, Final inspection, Closed

## Call log note

"About 40 status calls per week. Most callers give an address, not a permit number."

## Technology note

Permit Tracker has no public API. A nightly CSV export is available to staff.
